parsed.why: Only state criminalising bathroom use in private businesses and public buildings; universal exposure with up to a year jail, suit pending and no enforcement record. National hostile document/entry regime remains. Deep below parent.

Comprehensive state protections: public-accommodation anti-discrimination, 2023 full facilities access, hate-crime coverage, care shield and court order. National passport/entry risks and funding pressure cap it. Above parent.

No gender-identity anti-discrimination or hate-crime coverage; birth-marker changes closed; 2023 law permits bathroom restrictions in many state facilities. No criminal private-business ban, so above D1 but below parent.

Sanctuary care law and identity-based prison placement are protective, but no documented facilities or anti-discrimination coverage; highest raw anti-LGBTQ incident count lacks denominator. Moderately above parent.

Strong state anti-discrimination, hate-crime enhancement, no facility restriction and court-backed bathroom access, plus care protections. University sports capitulation and national framework limit it to moderately above parent.
